lines.speaker: Dustin Dowell
lines.text: Alright, everyone is here, let's get started. First item is the treasurer report.

lines.speaker: Maria Alvarez
lines.text: Cash on hand is up a bit from last month. The hosting bill dropped after the machine resizing.

lines.speaker: Sam Okafor
lines.text: How much did we save?

lines.speaker: Maria Alvarez
lines.text: About thirteen dollars a month. Small, but it adds up over the year.

lines.speaker: Dustin Dowell
lines.text: Good. Next is the client pipeline. Sam, you had two proposals out.

lines.speaker: Sam Okafor
lines.text: One signed yesterday, the site rebuild for the bakery. The other is waiting on their board.

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: Do we have capacity for both if the second one lands?

lines.speaker: Sam Okafor
lines.text: If it starts in October, yes. Earlier than that and we'd need the contractor.

lines.speaker: Dustin Dowell
lines.text: Let's put the hiring plan on next month's agenda then. Last item, the bylaws revision.

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: I posted the draft in documents. The main change is the quorum going to two thirds.

lines.speaker: Maria Alvarez
lines.text: I read it. I'm fine with the quorum change, the rest is cleanup.

lines.speaker: Dustin Dowell
lines.text: Then we vote on it at the members meeting. Anything for open floor?

lines.speaker: Sam Okafor
lines.text: Nothing from me.

lines.speaker: Dustin Dowell
lines.text: Okay, that's the meeting. Thanks everyone.

lines.speaker: Dustin Dowell
lines.text: Okay, we're live. Quick round on the bakery site before the treasurer report.

lines.speaker: Sam Okafor
lines.text: Design is approved. I'm starting the build tomorrow and I'll have a staging link by Thursday.

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: Do they want the online ordering in the first release or later?

lines.speaker: Sam Okafor
lines.text: Later. First release is the menu, hours, and the catering form.

lines.speaker: Maria Alvarez
lines.text: Good, that keeps the invoice inside what they approved.

lines.speaker: Dustin Dowell
lines.text: Treasurer report next. Maria, how does September look?

lines.speaker: Maria Alvarez
lines.text: Two invoices paid, one outstanding. Hosting came in at fifteen dollars after the resizing.

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: That's the lowest it has been.

lines.speaker: Dustin Dowell
lines.text: Nice. Last thing, the bylaws vote is at the members meeting on the fourteenth. Read the draft before then.
